criteria.text: Before submission, pdd reads authenticated runtime capacity; a maintenance window reports its end and reason, waits, then rechecks before sending.
A confirmed unstarted 503 maintenance response gets the same wait; capacity 404 permits compatibility through admission response codes.
Maintenance waiting shares the caller deadline and stops on interruption; authentication, access and unrelated service errors retain their existing handling.

cases.given: capacity announces deploy until fixed future time, then clear
cases.required_observation: no POST during window; one POST after recheck; print reason/end

cases.given: window exceeds agent 90 s, separately interrupt
cases.required_observation: no later POST; finite wait and plain progress
existing immediate gate, no maintenance loop
